- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Spotlight Pick Friend Persona Redesign: Redesign the pet selection interface into a spotlight stage layout highlighting pet personalities, traits, and desktop animations before selection. (why: Adoption has the largest drop-off in the funnel (60.9% conversion) and long completion times (median 89s), showing users hesitate when selecting a companion.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Interactive Mascot Desktop Onboarding Overlay Screen: Introduce a dedicated new finish screen featuring an interactive mascot step-by-step walk-through of desktop overlay controls. (why: Users experience post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control, hide, or talk to their pet (3 support emails) and drop off during the finish step (64.8%).)
2: [choose_path, redesign] Interactive Welcome Story Intro Redesign: Redesign the intro story screen into a split layout with animated mascot visuals and path preview highlights to introduce desktop pet capabilities early. (why: Mean time spent on choose_path is high (514s), indicating some users linger or hesitate before making an initial choice.)
3: [home, new_screen] Generation Progress and Compatibility Screen: Add a new stage screen during waiting that shows multi-step generation progress and system display checks. (why: Mean time on home (waiting) is 2336s with 3 support emails reporting pets not displaying on the desktop or failing during spawn.)
4: [sign_in, hint] Sign-In Account Sync Guidance Hint: Display a hint on the sign-in screen urging users to sign in with their original account method to keep existing pet data. (why: 8 support emails (the single largest issue theme) reported pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
5: [home, notification] Desktop Spawn Notification Toggle: Enable desktop notification opt-in on the waiting screen with an estimated completion timer so users know when generation finishes. (why: Home waiting stage has a long mean time (2336s), causing users to minimize or disengage before the pet spawns.)
